Name: Multiplayer Horse Reskin
Author: DellyBelly
Description:
[b][size=4]New in 2.0.0
[/size][/b][list]
[*]Config file no longer needed
[*]Asset names no longer need to be horse_1, horse_2... the mod will find all png files in its assets folder
[*]If you are updating from a previous version of this mod, you will need to re-select your horse textures on your first load.
[/list][b][size=4]Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Select different textures for horses in multiplayer
[*]Horse textures persist for all farmhands if they are using the same assets
[*]Right-click while standing inside stable to bring up reskin menu
[*]When using controller, use trigger buttons to scroll through horse textures
[/list][b][size=4]Installation steps
[/size][/b][list=1][*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Download and unzip the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods
[*]Add any horse replacement .png files that you want to use in this mod's [b]/assets[/b] folder
> popular asset files: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20042]Elle's Cuter Horses[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3169]Elle's New Horses[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15621]Otter's Horse Mod[/url]﻿

[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]

[b][size=4]Known Issues[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Probably not compatible with Adopt n Skin
[/list][b][size=4]
[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]SMAPI Commands
[/size][/b]
[spoiler]
In this first version of the mod, changing the horse skin is done through SMAPI console commands

[code]list_horses[/code]
[code]reskin_horse HorseName skinId[/code]
[code]reskin_horse_id HorseId skinId[/code]

[size=4][b]Example SMAPI Commands
[/b][/size]
[size=3][b]Reskin horse by providing horse name and skin id[/b][/size]
[code]reskin_horse Horsie 5
reskin_horse "Name with space" 5
[/code]
[size=3][b]Reskin horse by providing horse id and skin id[/b][/size]
(use this if you have more than one horse with the same name)
[code]reskin_horse 6e548f65-451b-4839-938b-e763361a2795 5
[/code]
[/spoiler]
[size=4][b]Thank you[/b][/size]
